notes: the first branch («حدثنا غندر، عن شعبة، ح») and the second («قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة») meet at Shu'ba; the names after the second «حدثنا شعبة» are written once and belong to both branches (rule 3)
«محمد بن جعفر» here is not merged with «غندر» (the first branch), since the text names them separately (rule 9)
the Companion Abu Bakra is the last link; the Prophet is the end
